<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  One entry of a menu: a link to its address, or, without one, its content as text in the same box (the magazine
  routes nothing, so it shows text). current marks the page the entry stands for (aria-current) either way.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";

  export type MenuEntryProps = {
    href?: string;
    current?: boolean;
    variant?: "default" | "muted" | "block";
    size?: "default" | "sm";
    testid?: string;
    block?: boolean;
    class?: string;
    children?: Snippet;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../compose/Box.svelte";
  import Inline from "../compose/Inline.svelte";
  import Link from "../compose/Link.svelte";
  import { urlOf } from "../utils";

  let {
    href,
    current = false,
    variant = "default",
    size = "default",
    testid,
    block = false,
    class: className,
    children,
  }: MenuEntryProps = $props();
</script>

{#if href}
  <Link
    href={urlOf(href)}
    variant={variant}
    size={size}
    aria-current={(current ? "page" : undefined)}
    class={className}
    data-testid={testid}
  >
    {@render children?.()}
  </Link>
{:else if block}
  <Box class={className} aria-current={(current ? "page" : undefined)} data-testid={testid}>
    {@render children?.()}
  </Box>
{:else}
  <Inline class={className} aria-current={(current ? "page" : undefined)} data-testid={testid}>
    {@render children?.()}
  </Inline>
{/if}
